name: fade-hold
description: Fork-local (2026-10-24, shortlist #4): what an NPC's fade-in value draws. The actors-crowd field south of Bruma, empty, then 10 Legion soldiers spawned 450 units in front. Run with -FixIni @{ FadeHoldTest = N } (N = value x 100; the DLL then holds every fade at that value) and compare the crowd shot with the empty one and with a run without the hold.
